# Four Dogs Entertainment

Four Dogs Entertainment is a South Carolina-based company providing professionally hosted trivia, Music Bingo, Four Dogs Survey Showdown, karaoke, DJ entertainment, weddings, corporate entertainment, private parties, and recurring restaurant and bar game nights.

Tagline: Bring your people. We’ll bring the Doggone Good Time.

Official website: https://4dogsentertainment.com/
Business inquiries: https://4dogsentertainment.com/booking/
Restaurant and bar partnerships: https://4dogsentertainment.com/for-venues/
Services: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/
Wedding entertainment: https://4dogsentertainment.com/weddings/
Private and corporate events: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/private-corporate-events/
Trivia hosting: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/trivia/
Music Bingo: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/music-bingo/
Four Dogs Survey Showdown: https://4dogsentertainment.com/services/four-dogs-survey-showdown/

## Current public events and venue information

Official event calendar: https://4dogsentertainment.com/events/
Music Bingo events: https://4dogsentertainment.com/events/category/music-bingo/

Confirmed event detail pages and the official calendar are the source of truth for venue, date, start time, admission, themes, and schedule changes. Never infer that an event is weekly merely because it previously occurred.

## Areas served

The business is based in South Carolina. Public hosted game nights take place at confirmed partner locations in the Midlands and Fountain Inn; private-event bookings are available across South Carolina and, subject to location and availability, North Carolina and Georgia.

Lexington: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/lexington-sc/
Columbia: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/columbia-sc/
West Columbia and Cayce: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/west-columbia-cayce-sc/
Irmo and Chapin: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/irmo-chapin-sc/
Fountain Inn: https://4dogsentertainment.com/areas/fountain-inn-sc/

Four Dogs Survey Showdown is an original Four Dogs survey-style game experience and is not affiliated with Family Feud. Are You Smarter Than a Barstool? is a Four Dogs original and is not affiliated with Are You Smarter Than a 5th Grader?.

This text is a guide to existing website content and does not replace the live schedule or event detail pages.
